item.title: Version 1.50.19 (151)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.50.19

  • Clear paste progress with file and byte counts, live folder-tree status, and safe cancellation.
  • Improved desktop Library toolbar, selection actions, folder loading feedback, and accessibility.
  • Refined responsive Home, support cards, and TIFF conversion layout.
